items.sentence: 我是学生。
items.py: Wǒ shì xuésheng.
items.en: I am a student.
items.explanation: Use 是 before a noun that identifies someone.

items.sentence: 你叫什么名字？
items.py: Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
items.en: What is your name?
items.explanation: 什么 asks what; 什么名字 asks for a name.

items.sentence: 这是我的书。
items.py: Zhè shì wǒ de shū.
items.en: This is my book.
items.explanation: 这是 introduces or identifies a thing.

items.sentence: 我不是老师，我是学生。
items.py: Wǒ bú shì lǎoshī, wǒ shì xuésheng.
items.en: I am not a teacher; I am a student.
items.explanation: Negate 是 with 不. Before fourth-tone 是, 不 is pronounced bú.

items.sentence: 他是我的朋友。
items.py: Tā shì wǒ de péngyou.
items.en: He is my friend.
items.explanation: 的 links the person to their friend: 我的朋友.

items.sentence: 你是学生吗？
items.py: Nǐ shì xuésheng ma?
items.en: Are you a student?
items.explanation: Add 吗 to turn a statement into a yes/no question.

items.sentence: 我学习汉语。
items.py: Wǒ xuéxí Hànyǔ.
items.en: I study Mandarin Chinese.
items.explanation: 学习汉语 means to study Mandarin Chinese.

items.sentence: 你女儿几岁？
items.py: Nǐ nǚ’ér jǐ suì?
items.en: How old is your daughter?
items.explanation: 女儿 means daughter. The question asks a person’s age.

items.prompt: 我有三个苹果，你有一个，我们有___个苹果。
items.sentence: 我有三个苹果，你有一个，我们有四个苹果。
items.py: Wǒ yǒu sān ge píngguǒ, nǐ yǒu yí ge, wǒmen yǒu sì ge píngguǒ.
items.en: I have three apples and you have one; we have four apples.
items.explanation: Three plus one makes four: 四.

items.sentence: 我有三本书。
items.py: Wǒ yǒu sān běn shū.
items.en: I have three books.
items.explanation: Use 本 to count books.

items.sentence: 她十岁。
items.py: Tā shí suì.
items.en: She is ten years old.
items.explanation: 岁 follows a number to give a person’s age.

items.sentence: 现在三点。
items.py: Xiànzài sān diǎn.
items.en: It is three o’clock now.
items.explanation: 点 follows the hour when telling the time.

items.sentence: 茶五块钱。
items.py: Chá wǔ kuài qián.
items.en: The tea costs five yuan.
items.explanation: 块 is the spoken unit for yuan.

items.sentence: 我有一个苹果。
items.py: Wǒ yǒu yí ge píngguǒ.
items.en: I have one apple.
items.explanation: 个 is the measure word used here for apples.

items.sentence: 今天星期一，明天星期二。
items.py: Jīntiān xīngqīyī, míngtiān xīngqī’èr.
items.en: Today is Monday; tomorrow is Tuesday.
items.explanation: The day after 星期一 is 星期二.

items.sentence: 一年有十二个月。
items.py: Yì nián yǒu shí’èr ge yuè.
items.en: A year has twelve months.
items.explanation: 月 is month; there are twelve months in a year.

items.sentence: 我想喝水。
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng hē shuǐ.
items.en: I would like to drink water.
items.explanation: 喝 is the verb used for drinking water.

items.sentence: 我们吃米饭。
items.py: Wǒmen chī mǐfàn.
items.en: We eat rice.
items.explanation: Use 吃 with food such as 米饭.

items.sentence: 我写字。
items.py: Wǒ xiě zì.
items.en: I write characters.
items.explanation: 写字 means to write characters.

items.sentence: 我去医院看医生。
items.py: Wǒ qù yīyuàn kàn yīshēng.
items.en: I go to the hospital to see a doctor.
items.explanation: 医院 is the place for seeing a doctor.

items.sentence: 请听，老师在说话。
items.py: Qǐng tīng, lǎoshī zài shuōhuà.
items.en: Please listen; the teacher is speaking.
items.explanation: 听 means listen; the next clause tells you someone is speaking.

items.sentence: 我在商店买衣服。
items.py: Wǒ zài shāngdiàn mǎi yīfu.
items.en: I buy clothes at the shop.
items.explanation: 买 means buy; 商店 is a shop.

items.sentence: 水在杯子里。
items.py: Shuǐ zài bēizi lǐ.
items.en: The water is inside the cup.
items.explanation: 里 locates something inside a container.

items.sentence: 你去学校做什么？
items.py: Nǐ qù xuéxiào zuò shénme?
items.en: What do you go to school to do?
items.explanation: 做什么 asks what activity someone will do.

items.sentence: 她是我的老师。
items.py: Tā shì wǒ de lǎoshī.
items.en: She is my teacher.
items.explanation: Use 是 to identify someone as your teacher.

items.sentence: 这是你的杯子吗？
items.py: Zhè shì nǐ de bēizi ma?
items.en: Is this your cup?
items.explanation: 你的杯子 means your cup; 的 connects owner and object.

items.sentence: 他不是医生，他是老师。
items.py: Tā bú shì yīshēng, tā shì lǎoshī.
items.en: He is not a doctor; he is a teacher.
items.explanation: 不是 is the negative of 是.

items.sentence: 你想喝什么？
items.py: Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme?
items.en: What would you like to drink?
items.explanation: 什么 asks for the thing to drink; 几 and 多少 ask quantities.

items.prompt: 我有五个苹果，他有一个，我们有___个苹果。
items.sentence: 我有五个苹果，他有一个，我们有六个苹果。
items.py: Wǒ yǒu wǔ ge píngguǒ, tā yǒu yí ge, wǒmen yǒu liù ge píngguǒ.
items.en: I have five apples and he has one; we have six apples.
items.explanation: Five plus one makes six: 六.

items.sentence: 他有三本书。
items.py: Tā yǒu sān běn shū.
items.en: He has three books.
items.explanation: 本 counts books.

items.sentence: 我女儿六岁。
items.py: Wǒ nǚ’ér liù suì.
items.en: My daughter is six years old.
items.explanation: 岁 expresses age in years.

items.sentence: 今天星期三，明天星期四。
items.py: Jīntiān xīngqīsān, míngtiān xīngqīsì.
items.en: Today is Wednesday; tomorrow is Thursday.
items.explanation: Thursday, 星期四, follows Wednesday.

items.sentence: 她想喝茶。
items.py: Tā xiǎng hē chá.
items.en: She would like to drink tea.
items.explanation: Tea is something to drink: 喝.

items.sentence: 我们去商店买苹果。
items.py: Wǒmen qù shāngdiàn mǎi píngguǒ.
items.en: We go to the shop to buy apples.
items.explanation: 商店 is the shop where you buy things.

items.sentence: 我写我的名字。
items.py: Wǒ xiě wǒ de míngzi.
items.en: I write my name.
items.explanation: 写 is write; the other actions do not work with 名字 here.

items.sentence: 请喝水。
items.py: Qǐng hē shuǐ.
items.en: Please drink water.
items.explanation: 喝 is the verb for drinking; the other choices do not work with water here.
